candidate_sentence_map.S1: Heimstaden reported stronger underlying performance in 2025, although rental income remained broadly unchanged because portfolio disposals, privatisations and foreign-exchange effects offset growth from the standing portfolio.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Rental income was SEK 15,916 million, compared with SEK 15,919 million in 2024, while annualised like-for-like rental growth remained solid at 4.9%, supported mainly by indexation, tenant improvements and occupancy gains.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: Real economic occupancy was stable at 98.5% for the year and reached 98.7% in the fourth quarter.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Profitability improved as cost controls and a smaller portfolio reduced operating expenses.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Property expenses declined 6.1% to SEK 4,378 million, despite utilities increasing 5.7% because supplier price increases exceeded core inflation.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: Net operating income rose to SEK 11,475 million from SEK 11,188 million, and the NOI margin increased to 72.1% from 70.3%.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Capital expenditure was SEK 4,439 million, including SEK 3,893 million on investment and improvement projects, with higher spending on maintenance and sustainability.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Tenant improvements generated SEK 94 million of additional rental income at an average yield on cost of 10.8%.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: Property values increased 3.0%, or SEK 9,498 million, during the year, supported by operating performance, value-accretive capital expenditure and stronger housing markets, particularly in Denmark and Czechia.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: The fair value of investment properties at year-end was SEK 324,429 million, down from SEK 335,422 million after divestments and currency effects.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: Privatisation activity remained significant: SEK 10,664 million of sales were completed, covering 2,466 units at a 28.9% premium to book value.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: Total realised gains from property divestments increased to SEK 2,207 million from SEK 1,687 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Profit before tax increased to SEK 16,012 million from SEK 10,403 million, supported by higher property gains, fair-value gains and a SEK 3,996 million foreign-exchange gain, compared with a loss in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: However, the group recorded a SEK 3,707 million goodwill impairment, primarily related to Germany and Sweden.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Profit for the year consequently rose to SEK 13,056 million from SEK 7,621 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: Total equity increased modestly to SEK 150,557 million, while currency translation losses of SEK 8,857 million limited comprehensive income.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: The balance sheet strengthened through debt reduction and asset sales.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Net loan-to-value improved to 52.2% from 56.4%, net debt to total assets fell to 48.0% from 51.0%, and the interest coverage ratio increased to 2.0x from 1.9x.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: Interest expense was broadly stable at SEK 6,536 million, although the average interest rate increased to 3.43% from 3.01%.
candidate_sentence_map.S20: Heimstaden Bostad completed approximately SEK 59.5 billion of financing and ended the year with SEK 23.4 billion of unused credit facilities.
candidate_sentence_map.S21: Operating cash flow was SEK 2,742 million, while year-end cash stood at SEK 4,179 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S22: Sustainability investments continued to support operational efficiency and financing access.
candidate_sentence_map.S23: Weather-corrected energy intensity declined 10%, and the group reported 14.2% progress against its emissions-reduction baseline.
candidate_sentence_map.S24: Green assets totalled approximately SEK 75.9 billion and outstanding green bonds reached SEK 13.8 billion.
candidate_sentence_map.S25: Subsequent to year-end, Heimstaden expects an accounting loss of approximately SEK 3 billion when its Kojamo ownership falls below 20%.
candidate_sentence_map.S26: The company proposed carrying forward all available earnings and paying no dividends.

evaluation.label: Generally yes
evaluation.justification: K1, K2, K3, K5 and K7 are PRESENT with core elements covered across multiple sentences. K4 is PARTIALLY_PRESENT as only Denmark and Czechia country-specific developments are mentioned, omitting other countries' performance details. K6 is MISSING as there is no mention of post-reporting-period events (arbitration award or hybrid note issuance). The overall coverage is strong but missing one HIGH criterion and partially covering another, justifying a 'Generally yes' score.
